goal: Introduce a dedicated helper class to contain HTML cleaning and validation logic currently implemented inline in Jsoup, so the Jsoup class can delegate and be smaller/cohesive.

ops.details: Create a new class org.jsoup.JsoupCleaner with public static methods that encapsulate the cleaning and validation behaviors currently implemented inside Jsoup: clean(String, String, Safelist), clean(String, Safelist), clean(String, String, Safelist, Document.OutputSettings), and isValid(String, Safelist). The implementations mirror the existing logic in Jsoup: handle DummyUri substitution when safelist.preserveRelativeLinks() and then parse the body fragment, call new Cleaner(safelist).clean(...) or .isValidBodyHtml(...) as appropriate, and apply output settings when provided. Place the new class in package org.jsoup and add necessary imports (org.jsoup.nodes.Document, org.jsoup.safety.Cleaner, org.jsoup.safety.Safelist, org.jsoup.Parser, org.jsoup.internal.SharedConstants.DummyUri). This class is a pure facade/helper and does not change public APIs of Jsoup.
